## Free GRC products (small SaaS proof — under brand)

- Identity first: Security and Compliance Analyst. Free packs are open work samples, not a template-shop brand.

## Labs (findings — one line each)

- Phishing Header Forensics — sending domain had no usable SPF/DKIM/DMARC; origin traced to hosting ISP, not the claimed mail provider. https://jpcarpenter.com/labs/phishing-header-forensics
- Network Segmentation — ping proves reachability not segmentation; decremented TTL confirmed inter-VLAN routing. https://jpcarpenter.com/labs/network-segmentation
- Browser exposure — repeat visitor recognition without cookies is local-only, disclosed, and revocable on this site. https://jpcarpenter.com/labs/browser-exposure
- Risk Gauge — needle and written rating share one computation (GRC instrument). https://jpcarpenter.com/labs/risk-gauge
- TINKER-SCOPE — no charting library; knobs drive real parameters. https://jpcarpenter.com/labs/tinker-scope

## Security posture (summary — verify on the wire)

- Human-teachable posture page: https://jpcarpenter.com/security — plain-language expand rows
  with citations (same facts as below; denser teaching format for hiring managers / peers)
- Static site; no accounts; no form submissions; no third-party JS
- CSP: script-src 'self'; no 'unsafe-inline'; Trusted Types; form-action 'none'
- HSTS with includeSubDomains; preload directive present; www A removed (apex only)
- HSTS preload: submitted (hstspreload.org status pending; Chromium list lag is normal)
- CAA: issue letsencrypt.org; iodef mailto:jp@jpcarpenter.com
- Origin nginx: server_tokens off; Accept negotiation on /about (Vary: Accept); unified header snippet on HTML + /_astro/
- Origin rate limits: 20r/s per IP, burst 80 nodelay; 40 concurrent conns; 429 when exceeded (human browsing unaffected)
- Canary tripwire watched (hit log always; email best-effort); path unpublished on /security
- Host: fail2ban sshd; unattended-upgrades; unused nginx modules not loaded
- CT watch: daily crt.sh poll (discovery after issuance; CAA remains prevention)
- Header drift monitor: npm run headers-ci + weekly GitHub Action (not a full ZAP suite; not a deploy gate)
- AI policy: block named training crawlers; allow search/citation bots (see robots.txt)
- No sitewide CAPTCHA (would weaken CSP without stopping raw GET scrapers)
